small_guidance:
- The accumulator is declared as `(BLOCK_N, BLOCK_M)` and `tl.dot(x_tile, w_tile)` is `(BLOCK_N, BLOCK_K) @ (BLOCK_K, BLOCK_M)` — this is the transposed GEMM orientation. Swap to the standard `(BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N)` accumulator with `pid_m` over output spatial (N*OH*OW) and `pid_n` over OC; this lets `tl.dot` use the fast TF32/FMA path and improves the weight-load coalescing pattern (weights stored as `[K_total, OC]` will load as contiguous rows along N).
- Enable TF32 (`allow_tf32=True`) — the reference `nn.Conv2d` uses TF32 on Ampere, so matching it is both faster and within tolerance. Also add larger autotune configs once correctness holds: `(128,128,32)` and `(128,64,32)` at `num_warps=8, num_stages=2` — SMEM cost `(128·32+32·128)·4·2 = 64KB` fits comfortably.
- KH=KW=3, IC=64 → K_total=576. Make `KH`/`KW` constexpr (already done) and unroll the K loop by fixing `BLOCK_K=64` or 72 so the inner trip count is small (9 iters), and skip the `ih_ok/iw_ok` masking since with padding=0 and offsets `oh+kh`, `ow+kw` are always in-bounds — those branches are dead weight.
large_guidance:
- Switch to an implicit-GEMM with the canonical layout: program tiles `(BLOCK_M over N*OH*OW, BLOCK_N over OC)`, accumulator `(BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N)`, weight packed as `[IC*KH*KW, OC]` loaded contiguously along OC. This is the standard high-throughput shape and avoids the transposed-dot penalty the current kernel pays.
- Since padding=0 here, drop all spatial bounds checking in the inner loop — `ih = oh+kh, iw = ow+kw` are always valid. This removes a large mask-AND per K iteration. Keep only the M-tail mask on the store.
- Consider a split-K or persistent design only if needed; first priority is correct GEMM orientation + TF32. Also weight-pack once in `__init__` (store the `[K_total, OC]` reshaped weight as a buffer) so the per-forward `permute().contiguous().view()` cost is amortized away.
